from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.lookdev import get_material_library
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Material_Library(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_material_library"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("query",    "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("category", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]
        self.add_output("materials_json",  "string")
        self.add_output("material_count",  "int")
        self.add_output("statistics_json", "string")

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        query    = str(inputs.get("query",    "") or "")
        category = str(inputs.get("category", "") or "")
        try:
            lib = get_material_library()
            materials = lib.search_materials(query=query, category=category)
            stats = lib.get_statistics()
            self.log_info(f"Material Library: found {len(materials)} material(s).")
            return {
                "materials_json":  json.dumps([m.to_dict() for m in materials], sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "material_count":  len(materials),
                "statistics_json": json.dumps(stats, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Material Library query failed: {exc}")
            return {"materials_json": "[]", "material_count": 0, "statistics_json": "{}", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Material_Library
